review.reason: The course layout, mapped hazards, tees, greens, and water appear faithful, and each green reads as a continuous putting surface. The Hole 1 fairway stripes run lengthwise along the tee-to-green direction rather than crossing the fairway, so the current artwork does not meet the required stripe treatment.

issues.detail: The upper Hole 1 fairway has predominantly horizontal mowing bands, parallel to the T1-to-G1 route, instead of bands crossing the fairway perpendicular to play.
issues.consequence: At overview scale, the fairway reads as having the wrong mowing orientation and does not clearly show the required crosswise striping.
